'''Cody Williams''' (born November 20, 2004) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado Buffaloes]]. He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2023 class.

==Early life and high school career==
Williams was born in [[San Luis Obispo, California]] and has grown up in [[Gilbert, Arizona]] after his family moved there when he was young.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://arizonavarsity.rivals.com/news/commitment-analysis-cody-williams-commits-to-colorado|title=Commitment Analysis: Cody Williams commits to Colorado|first=Jacob|last=Seliga|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=November 9, 2022|access-date=February 1, 2023}}</ref> He attended [[Perry High School (Gilbert, Arizona)|Perry High School]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eastvalleytribune.com/sports/cody-williams-becoming-star-for-perry-basketball/article_5df7f244-7ab1-11eb-a9b6-abb2ecf7747f.html|title=Cody Williams becoming star for Perry basketball|first=Zach|last=Alvira|work=[[East Valley Tribune]]|date=March 1, 2021|access-date=February 1, 2023}}</ref> As a junior, Williams was named the Premier Region Player of the Year after averaging 13 points, four rebounds, three assists, and two steals per game as Perry won the Class 6A state championship.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.azcentral.com/story/sports/high-school/2022/11/09/perry-5-star-basketball-recruit-cody-williams-signs-colorado/8316757001/|title=Perry 5-star basketball recruit Cody Williams signs with Colorado|work=[[The Arizona Republic]]|date=November 9, 2022|access-date=February 1, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.azcentral.com/story/sports/high-school/2022/03/02/cody-williams-koa-peat-lead-perry-first-state-basketball-title/9354909002/|title=Cody Williams, Koa Peat lead Perry to first state basketball title|work=[[The Arizona Republic]]|date=March 2, 2022|access-date=February 1, 2023}}</ref> Williams averaged 18.4 points, 6.7 rebounds, and four assists per game as a senior while leading the Pumas to a 30–1 record and a second consecutive state championship.<ref>{{cite web |last=Divens |first=Jordan |date=March 29, 2023 |title=2022-23 MaxPreps All-America Team: Cameron Boozer of Columbus headlines high school basketball's best |url=https://www.maxpreps.com/news/SxUDpqUOuUW4VE3APSX7fw/2022-23-maxpreps-all-america-team-cameron-boozer-of-columbus-headlines-high-school-basketballs-best.htm |access-date=August 5, 2023 |work=[[MaxPreps.com]]}}</ref>
Williams was selected to play in the [[2023 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]] during his senior year.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.denverpost.com/2023/01/25/baye-fall-cody-williams-mcdonalds-all-americans/|title=Colorado’s Baye Fall, CU Buffs recruit Cody Williams named McDonald’s All Americans|work=[[The Denver Post]]|date=January 25, 2023|access-date=February 1, 2023}}</ref> He was also selected to play for Team USA in the [[Nike Hoops Summit]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://colorado.rivals.com/news/colorado-signee-cody-williams-named-to-team-usa-roster-for-nike-hoop-summit|title=Colorado signee Cody Williams named to Team USA roster for Nike Hoop Summit|first=Craig|last=Meyer|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=February 14, 2023|access-date=February 15, 2023}}</ref>

===Recruiting===
Williams was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2023 class, according to major recruiting services.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://tucson.com/sports/arizonawildcats/basketball/pascoe/arizona-target-cody-williams-rises-to-no-14-in-espn-class-of-2023-rankings/article_e65bf24c-27bd-11ed-8f23-c7d27f99ab52.html|title=Arizona target Cody Williams rises to No. 14 in ESPN class of 2023 rankings|work=[[Arizona Daily Star]]|date=August 29, 2022|access-date=February 1, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/Article/College-basketball-recruiting-top-25-Cody-Williams-discusses-final-eight-Arizona-Colorado-Georgia-Tech-LMU-LSU-Santa-Clara-UCLA-USC-193333815/|title=Top 25 senior Cody Williams updates his recruitment in the midst of visits|first=Eric|last=Bossi|website=[[247Sports]]|date=September 13, 2022|access-date=February 1, 2023}}</ref> On November 9, 2022, Williams committed to playing college basketball for [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado]] after considering offers from [[LSU Tigers men's basketball|LSU]], [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona]], [[UCLA Bruins men's basketball|UCLA]], and [[USC Trojans men's basketball|USC]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/34986747/colorado-lands-first-five-star-recruit-tad-boyle-tenure|title=Colorado lands first five-star recruit of Tad Boyle's tenure|first1=Jeff|last1=Borzello|first2=Paul|last2=Biancardi|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=November 9, 2022|access-date=February 1, 2023}}</ref> He became the highest-ranked committed recruit in program history and the first five-star recruit to join Colorado.

==National team career==
Williams was named to the [[United States men's national under-19 basketball team|United States under-19 basketball team]], which was coached by Colorado head coach [[Tad Boyle]], to play in the [[2023 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/colorado/article/colorado-basketball-buffaloes-forward-cody-williams-makes-2023-u-211662556/|title=Cody Williams makes the 2023 USA U19 men's national team|first=Adam|last=Munsterteiger|website=[[247Sports]]|date=June 16, 2023|access-date=June 21, 2023}}</ref>
